tEn: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
tZh: Command A：一款面向企业的商用级大型语言模型
sEn: Command A is an enterprise-ready large language model with a hybrid architecture, multilingual support for 23 languages, and advanced RAG capabilities, developed via decentralized training and released for research.
sZh: Command A是一款面向企业的大型语言模型，具备混合架构、23种语言支持和先进的检索增强生成能力，通过去中心化训练开发，并已发布研究权重。
absEn: In this report we describe the development of Command A, a powerful large language model purpose-built to excel at real-world enterprise use cases. Command A is an agent-optimised and multilingual-capable model, with support for 23 languages of global business, and a novel hybrid architecture balancing efficiency with top of the range performance. It offers best-in-class Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities with grounding and tool use to automate sophisticated business processes. These abilities are achieved through a decentralised training approach, including self-refinement algorithms and model merging techniques. We also include results for Command R7B which shares capability and architectural similarities to Command A. Weights for both models have been released for research purposes. This technical report details our original training pipeline and presents an extensive evaluation of our models across a suite of enterprise-relevant tasks and public benchmarks, demonstrating excellent performance and efficiency.
absZh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Command A的开发，这是一款专为真实企业场景设计的强大大型语言模型。Command A是一款面向智能体优化且支持多语言的模型，支持全球商业中使用的23种语言，并采用新颖的混合架构，兼顾效率与顶尖性能。它提供了业界领先的检索增强生成（RAG）能力，具备事实锚定和工具使用功能，可自动化复杂的业务流程。这些能力通过去中心化的训练方法实现，包括自优化算法和模型合并技术。我们还提供了Command R7B的结果，该模型与Command A在能力和架构上具有相似性。两个模型的权重均已发布以供研究使用。本技术报告详细介绍了我们的原创训练流程，并在一系列企业相关任务和公开基准上对我们的模型进行了广泛评估，展示了出色的性能和效率。

paras.en: Abstract In this report we describe the development of Command A, a powerful large language model purpose-built to excel at real-world enterprise use cases. Command A is an agent-optimised and multilingual-capable model, with support for 23 languages of global business, and a novel hybrid architecture balancing efficiency with top of the range performance. It offers best-in-class Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities with grounding and tool use to automate sophisticated business processes. These abilities are achieved through a decentralised training approach, including self-refinement algorithms and model merging techniques. We also include results for Command R7B which shares capability and architectural similarities to Command A. Weights for both models have been released for research purposes. This technical report details our original training pipeline and presents an extensive evaluation of our models across a suite of enterprise-relevant tasks and public benchmarks, demonstrating excellent performance and efficiency.
paras.zh: 摘要 在本报告中,我们介绍了 Command A 的开发,这是一个强大的大语言模型,专为在真实世界企业用例中表现出色而设计。Command A 是一个面向智能体优化且支持多语言的模型,支持 23 种全球商业语言,并采用新颖的混合架构,在效率与顶级性能之间取得平衡。它提供了业界领先的检索增强生成(RAG)能力,结合接地(grounding)和工具使用,可自动化复杂的业务流程。这些能力是通过去中心化的训练方法实现的,包括自精炼算法和模型合并技术。我们还提供了 Command R7B 的结果,它与 Command A 在能力和架构上具有相似性。两个模型的权重已发布供研究使用。本技术报告详细介绍了我们原始的训练流程,并在一系列企业相关任务和公共基准上对我们的模型进行了广泛评估,展示了卓越的性能和效率。

paras.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are Artificial Intelligence (AI) models designed to understand and generate human-like text conditioned on the input they receive. Recent advancements have led to remarkable breakthroughs in their ability to comprehend and produce human language with unparalleled accuracy and fluency. This progress has been instrumental in their widespread adoption across various real-world and enterprise environments, where they significantly boost operational efficiency and deepen understanding. This technical report describes the development of Command A and Command R7B, two LLMs designed to excel in real-world enterprise settings. Both the 111B parameter Command A and Command R7B perform best-in-class across a suite of established benchmarks for their respective model sizes. We also highlight key innovations and technical contributions including data and architectural optimisations, self-refinement algorithms, and a model merging-based approach optimised to bring out expert-level performance across capabilities within a single set of model weights, providing fast and efficient performance. Command A is tailored for excellent performance in enterprise-relevant settings such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), where models can interact with, understand, and process information distributed across a wide range of documents. As part of this focus, our models also excel in the multilingual setting, supporting 23 key languages of global business: English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Czech, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Romanian, Greek, Hindi, Hebrew, and Persian. Along with its impressive overall performance, achieving best-in-class results for any model in its size and efficiency range on common benchmarks such as MATH, Command A outperforms across an extensive suite of human evaluation tasks as shown in Figure 1. Furthermore, Command A achieves strong results on enterprise-relevant agentic benchmarks such as Taubench, as shown in Table 1. Command A focuses on delivering competitive performance as efficiently as possible. With a serving footprint of just two A100s or H100s, Command A requires considerably less computational overhead than comparable models. This is of particular importance for privacy-preserving enterprise settings and on-premises deployments. Command A can deliver tokens at a rate of up to 156 tokens/sec which is 1.75x higher than GPT-4o and 2.4x higher than DeepSeek V3. 1 Please cite this technical report as “Cohere (2025)”. A full author list can be found at the end of this document.
paras.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)是人工智能(AI)模型,旨在根据接收到的输入理解并生成类似人类的文本。最新的进展使其在理解和生成人类语言方面的能力取得了显著突破,达到了无与伦比的准确性和流畅性。这一进展对于它们在各种真实世界和企业环境中的广泛采用起到了重要作用,在这些环境中,它们显著提升了运营效率并加深了理解。本技术报告介绍了 Command A 和 Command R7B 的开发,这两个 LLM 旨在在真实企业环境中表现出色。无论是 1110 亿参数的 Command A 还是 Command R7B,都在一系列既定基准上各自取得了同类最佳的表现。我们还重点介绍了关键的创新和技术贡献,包括数据和架构优化、自精炼算法,以及一种基于模型合并的方法,该方法经过优化,可在单一的模型权重集中带来跨各项能力的专家级性能,提供快速且高效的性能。Command A 专为在检索增强生成(RAG)等企业相关场景中实现卓越性能而定制,在这些场景中,模型可以交互、理解并处理分布在大量文档中的信息。作为这一重点的一部分,我们的模型在多语言环境中也表现出色,支持全球商业的 23 种主要语言:英语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、德语、葡萄牙语、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语、中文、俄语、波兰语、土耳其语、越南语、荷兰语、捷克语、印尼语、乌克兰语、罗马尼亚语、希腊语、印地语、希伯来语和波斯语。除了其令人印象深刻的整体表现之外,Command A 在诸如 MATH 等常见基准上取得了任何模型在其规模和效率范围内的最佳结果,并在如图 1 所示的大量人工评估任务中表现优于其他模型。此外,Command A 在诸如 Taubench 等企业相关的智能体基准上取得了强劲的结果,如表 1 所示。Command A 专注于尽可能高效地提供具有竞争力的性能。凭借仅需两台 A100 或 H100 的服务占用,Command A 比同类模型所需的计算开销要少得多。这对于保护隐私的企业环境和本地部署尤为重要。Command A 可以以高达 156 tokens/sec 的速度提供词元,是 GPT-4o 的 1.75 倍,DeepSeek V3 的 2.4 倍。1 请引用本技术报告为 “Cohere (2025)”。完整的作者列表见本文件末尾。

paras.en: Pre-training language models involves training a model on trillions of tokens of unlabelled text data to learn general language patterns, syntax, and semantics, enabling it to generate contextually relevant responses. This foundational step leverages self-supervised learning techniques, such as next-token prediction, to build a versatile representation of language that can subsequently be fine-tuned for specific downstream tasks. Pre-training is computationally intensive but essential for achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse natural language processing applications.
paras.zh: 预训练语言模型涉及在数万亿词元的未标记文本数据上训练模型,以学习一般的语言模式、语法和语义,使其能够生成与上下文相关的响应。这一基础步骤利用自监督学习技术(如下一个词预测)来构建通用的语言表示,这些表示随后可针对特定的下游任务进行微调。预训练计算量巨大,但对于在各类自然语言处理应用中实现最先进的性能至关重要。

paras.en: Command A models are trained on multilingual data (also see Section 3.3.3.1) from various sources including publicly available text and code data from the web, a collection of synthetic datasets generated internally, instruction-tuning datasets obtained from human annotators, and high quality data sourced from specialised data vendors. We optimise the web text data by enhancing the ratio of educational samples that are relatively sparse on the internet, and down-sampling low-quality samples identified by Machine Learning (ML)-based quality filters after careful de-duplication and heuristic filtering for safety and quality. The final data mixture is determined by running a series of ablations using smaller models.
paras.zh: Command A 模型使用来自多种来源的多语言数据(另见第 3.3.3.1 节)进行训练,这些来源包括公开可用的网络文本和代码数据、内部生成的合成数据集集合、从人工标注者处获得的指令微调数据集,以及来自专业数据供应商的高质量数据。我们通过提高互联网上相对稀缺的教育样本比例来优化网络文本数据,并在经过仔细的去重和启发式过滤以确保安全和质量之后,对机器学习(ML)质量过滤器识别的低质量样本进行下采样。最终的数据混合是通过使用较小模型进行一系列消融实验确定的。

We use µP and µTransfer (Yang et al., 2021) to tune hyper-parameters on smaller models and zero-shot transfer them to our larger models. Sweeps are performed for each model size as they assume a fixed number of layers. 2.4.1
